function: Excluded for system: the learned receiver works on a single-antenna (SISO) NOMA-OFDM satellite downlink without RIS, scalar model y = H s + w (p. 3, Eq. 2).
notes: System exclusion. The link is SISO: scalar model yk,n = Hk,n sk + wk,n (p. 3, Eq. 2), one satellite beam per user cluster (p. 2), and no antenna array, MIMO, beamforming or RIS appears anywhere in the paper. The learned parts are channel estimation (DeepReCE, CNN) and multi-user detection (IDLMuD, LSTM) with BER as the main metric (pp. 4-6, 11-12), so the work is area 1, and the single-antenna exemption of OTFS and NTN (areas 4 and 6) does not apply. Power allocation is done by the sparrow search algorithm, which is not learned (p. 7), so area 6 does not fit. Borderline: the setting is a LEO NTN link (p. 2). If the reviewer admits it as an NTN work, the other checks pass: NTN-TDL-A channel of 3GPP TR 38.901 (p. 8), BER against SIC, AMP and LSTM (pp. 8, 11-13), complexity orders and 0.072947 s per user (p. 9), no code link.
